about: A 2026 limited release toro and the first Stolen Throne cigar made with a shaggy foot. It comes in 10-count bundles, with 10,000 cigars made.

about: A 2026 limited release built on the Preakness 150 blend, reworked for more strength and body. It comes in a single 5 x 54 size in 10-count bundles, with 10,000 cigars made.

about: A 2026 limited release belicoso named after founder Lee Marsh's family dog, the second cigar dedicated to him after Argos. Production was announced at 10,000 cigars.

about: Plasencia's third Lunar New Year cigar, a Nicaraguan puro built mainly on tobacco from Jalapa. It was released in January 2023 and limited to 6,000 boxes of 10.
